title: Do tampons or cups affect virginity
answer: Using a tampon or menstrual cup does not take away your virginity. Virginity is about whether a person has had sex, not about a product used for periods. You can choose any product you feel comfortable with.

title: Wearing two pads at once
answer: Some girls wear two pads at once on heavy days to avoid leaks. It is okay for a short time, but it can feel bulky and rub, and it may not stop leaks better than one larger night pad that fits well. Placing one pad a little further back is useful when lying down. If you regularly need two pads or soak through one in an hour or two, your bleeding may be heavy, so see a health worker.
